allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client hostnames or IP addresses (exact match only). Empty list = allow all.

items.description: Client hostname or IP address string (e.g., 192.168.1.50, iio-client.local).

backend_options.description: Key-value options passed directly to the active backend (e.g., timeout_ms, keepalive). See backend documentation for supported keys.

ca_cert_path.description: Path to PEM-encoded CA certificate to validate client certs (mutual TLS). Leave empty to disable client verification.

discovery_name.description: Custom mDNS name to advertise (e.g., 'my-iio-server'). If omitted, hostname is used.

enable_discovery.description: Enable mDNS/DNS-SD publishing of this IIO daemon so clients can auto-discover it.

enable_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for remote connections. Requires valid cert/key paths.

listen_address.description: IP address (e.g., 127.0.0.1, 192.168.1.10, or ::) to bind iiod listening socket. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity. One of: debug, info, warning, error. Higher levels suppress less critical logs.

port.description: TCP port for remote IIO connections. Ports < 1024 require root; use ≥ 1024 for non-root operation.

tls_cert_path.description: Path to PEM-encoded TLS server certificate. Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_key_path.description: Path to PEM-encoded TLS private key. Required if TLS is enabled.

transport.description: Communication transport method: 'ip' (network), 'usb' (USB-IO), or 'local' (local IIO devices only).
